Prototype 5 encodes N2 (100% pure) primarily through EOG (46%), with EEG (35%) and EMG (18%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows absence of δ (-10.8 dB, sensitivity=4.3) and absence of γ (+15.5 dB, sensitivity=2.3).
The δ activity is present in 0% of each epoch (transient), with moderate eye movements (SEM 0% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with N2 physiology: confirmed: σ elevated, EOG quiescent; missing: σ relevant.
